title: Pak Bung Bruschetta
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make appetizer or snack, perfect for a quick morning pick-me-up or an elegant dinner party. Bruschetta is toasted bread rubbed with garlic and topped with diced tomatoes, basil, and mozzarella, then finished with a drizzle of balsamic glaze.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together minced garlic and chopped pak bung.
3. Arrange the bread slices on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
4. Rub the toasted bread with the garlic-pak bung mixture.
5. Top each bread slice with diced tomatoes, shredded mozzarella, and a sprinkle of chopped morning glory.
6. Drizzle with balsamic glaze and serve immediately.
